name: P3 Correction + P1 Leverage Stress Test Specification

pillar_roles.P1: Match Context / Situational Difficulty (LEVERAGE SIGNAL ONLY - 0 direct points)
pillar_roles.P2: Individual Batter Execution (SCORING PILLAR - 50% Final Weight)

issue_1_death_rrr_blowout.problem: As balls remaining -> 0 in death overs of a losing chase, exit required RR explodes asymptotically, creating massive unearned negative RRR changes (e.g. -85.38) that drag elite batting (Russell 65 off 25, SR 260) down to P3=18.6.
issue_1_death_rrr_blowout.formula: if balls_rem_exit <= 12 and balls_faced >= 5 and raw_rrr_chg < 0: if actual_sr >= 160.0: rrr_chg = max(raw_rrr_chg, -3.0) elif actual_sr >= 130.0: rrr_chg = max(raw_rrr_chg, -6.0) else: rrr_chg = np.clip(raw_rrr_chg, -12.0, 12.0)
issue_1_death_rrr_blowout.distinction_preserved: Slow death batters (SR < 130) receive full unmitigated RRR penalty (-12.0), receiving P3 <= 15.0.

issue_2_partner_coattail.problem: When partner dominates scoring (>2.5x runs or batter share < 30%), the macro trajectory surge (+1.69) overwhelms partner differential (-0.44), awarding passive anchors (Dhawan 29 off 30) inflated P3=92.0.
issue_2_partner_coattail.formula: is_coattail = (macro_score > 0 and part_runs >= 35 and (b_share < 0.30 or (p_runs >= 2.5 * max(1.0, actual_runs) and partner_sr >= actual_sr + 30.0))); if is_coattail: macro_score *= max(0.25, min(1.0, 2.0 * b_share)); part_score -= min(0.60, 0.25 * ((partner_sr - actual_sr) / 40.0))
issue_2_partner_coattail.distinction_preserved: Carrying partners (share >= 65%, SR >= 130) retain full credit and receive synergy bonus (+0.30).

issue_3_low_target_chase.problem: In trivial chases (target <= 125), cruising at low SR still liquidates high % of target, artificially awarding slow batters (Smith 15 off 18) P3=68.2.
issue_3_low_target_chase.formula: if target <= 125.0 and macro_score > 0 and actual_sr < 100.0 and req_rr_entry <= 7.0 and balls_faced >= 10: macro_score = min(0.30, macro_score)
issue_3_low_target_chase.distinction_preserved: Aggressive finishers (e.g. 32 off 14, SR 228.6) retain full high P3 (80.7) and high contribution (75.6).
